products.name: Business Verification Solution
products.description: An online service that helps a business confirm the legitimacy of another business and its owners during onboarding. It combines enriched data, confidence scoring, TIN match, OFAC screening, and linked-business analysis to reduce fraud and support KYB compliance, and is available in near real time through the Equifax Developer Portal.
products.positioning: Presented as a real-time Know Your Business platform that pairs business-entity verification with digital identity trust and employment or ownership validation.
products.targetAudience: US lenders, financial institutions, insurers, internet and phone service providers, and other business service providers that onboard new business accounts, vendors, or partners at scale.

features.name: OFAC Screening
features.description: Screens the business against Office of Foreign Assets Control lists to check for sanctions exposure.
points: Automated screening against OFAC sanctions lists

features.name: TIN Match and IRS Verification
features.description: Checks the active status of a business Tax Identification Number directly against IRS records.
points: Confirms EIN status using IRS data
Acts as a legitimacy signal for the business

features.name: Business Verification Index
features.description: Analyzes the business entity and returns a confidence score for fraud potential during onboarding.
points: Uses enriched data to produce a fraud-potential index
Reviews business name, legal name, and address matches
Available in near real time via API

features.name: Digital Identity Trust Integration
features.description: Uses several identity and digital data points to verify the applicant as part of business verification.
points: Checks that the applicant is who they claim to be

products.name: Account Verification
products.description: A service that confirms bank-account ownership and status to reduce payment risk before a transaction is initiated.
products.targetAudience: Lenders and billers that initiate ACH or other account-based payments.

features.name: Account Ownership Check
features.description: Confirms that the consumer or business owns the bank account provided.
points: Matches the account holder to the applicant identity

features.name: Account Status Check
features.description: Confirms the account is open and in good standing before a debit is attempted.
points: Checks the account is active before debit

products.name: Equifax Developer Portal
products.description: A self-service portal where developers reach Equifax APIs, documentation, and sandbox environments to integrate verification and credit services.
products.targetAudience: Developers and integration teams at Equifax customers.
products.pricing: Free to browse; API usage is priced per product.

features.name: API Documentation
features.description: Reference documentation and integration guides for each Equifax API.

features.name: Sandbox Environment
features.description: A test environment with mock data for integration work before go-live.
